arxiv-2101-01518.title: Handling Mobility in Low-Power Wide-Area Network
arxiv-2101-01518.creator: Dali Ismail Abusayeed Saifullah
arxiv-2101-01518.description: Abstract Despite the proliferation of mobile devices in various wide-area Internet of Things applications (e.g., smart city, smart farming), current Low-Power Wide-Area Networks (LPWANs) are not designed to effectively support mobile nodes. In this paper, we propose to handle mobility in SNOW (Sensor Network Over White spaces), an LPWAN that operates in the TV white spaces.

arxiv-2108-04237.creator: Anton A. Kutsenko
arxiv-2108-04237.description: Abstract Loop counting functions U ⁡ ( x ) U(x) estimate the number of “weighted" loops in a digital representation of x ∈ [ − 1 , 1 ] x\in[-1,1] . Roughly speaking, each x x is considered as an infinite walk, where the steps of the walk correspond to digits of x x .

arxiv-2206-15308.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Zongchen Chen, Andreas Galanis, Leslie Ann Goldberg, Heng Guo, Andrés Herrera-Poyatos, Nitya Mani, Ankur Moitra. We give a nearly linear-time algorithm to approximately sample satisfying assignments in the random k k -SAT model when the density of the formula scales exponentially with k k .

arxiv-2404-18390.title: Critical grid method: An extensible Smoothed Particle Hydrodynamics fluid general interpolation method for Fluid-Structure Interaction surface coupling based on preCICE
arxiv-2404-18390.creator: Sifan Long, Xiaowei Guo, Xiaokang Fan, Canqun Yang
arxiv-2404-18390.description: Abstract Solving Fluid-Structure Interaction (FSI) problems using traditional methods is a big challenge in the field of numerical simulation. As a powerful multi-physical field coupled library, preCICE has a bright application prospect for solving FSI, which supports many open/closed source software and commercial CFD solvers to solve FSI problems in the form of a black box.

arxiv-2503-16039.title: How much should we care about what others know? Jump signals in optimal investment under relative performance concerns Thanks: PB gratefully acknowledges financial support by Deutsche Forschungsgemeinschaft through CRC/TRR 388 “Rough Analysis, Stochastic Dynamics and Related Fields”, Projects B03 an
arxiv-2503-16039.creator: Peter Bank and Gemma Sedrakjan Technische Universität Berlin
arxiv-2503-16039.description: Abstract . We present a multi-agent and mean-field formulation of a game between investors who receive private signals informing their investment decisions and who interact through relative performance concerns. A key tool in our model is a Poisson random measure which drives jumps in both market prices and signal processes and thus captures common and idiosyncratic noise.

arxiv-2506-18854.title: Comparative analysis of machine learning techniques for feature selection and classification of Fast Radio Bursts
arxiv-2506-18854.creator: Ailton J. B. Júnior, Jéferson A. S. Fortunato, Leonardo J. Silvestre, Thonimar V. Alencar, Wiliam S. Hipólito-Ricaldi
arxiv-2506-18854.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Ailton J. B. Júnior, Jéferson A. S. Fortunato, Leonardo J. Silvestre, Thonimar V. Alencar, Wiliam S. Hipólito-Ricaldi. Fast Radio Bursts (FRBs) are millisecond-duration radio transients of extragalactic origin, exhibiting a wide range of physical and observational properties. Distinguishing between repeating and non-repeating FRBs remains a key challenge in understanding their nature. In this work, we apply unsupervised machine learning techniques to classify FRBs based on both primary observables from the CHIME catalog and physically motivated derived features.

pmc-12480168.title: Study to Establish a National Dose Management System for Dental Imaging Examinations
pmc-12480168.creator: Ji Yun Lee, Jung Su Kim, Sang Wook Yoon, You Jeong Min, Jong Won Gil, Jong Hun Won, Chena Lee, 지윤 이, 정수 김, 상욱 윤, 유정 민, 종원 길, 종훈 원, 채나 이
pmc-12480168.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). With the rapid advancements in x-ray technology in the medical field, the use of diagnostic radiation has been increasing. Consequently, concerns about radiation exposure have been increasing since its introduction. In dentistry, radiation exposure during imaging examinations is relatively low, and a high frequency of these procedures, particularly the extensive use of dental cone-beam computed tomography (CBCT), has amplified concerns among users and the general public. This highlights the need for a dose management system tailored to dental x-ray equipment.

pmc-12535022.title: Two-year retrospective review of costs associated with COVID-19 case management in Regina, Saskatchewan
pmc-12535022.creator: Olanrewaju Medu, Molly Trecker, Tania Diener, Maurice Hennink, Doug Coyle, Jessica Minion, Cara Benz, Amanda Lang, Maureen Anderson, Thomas Stewart, Tandi Steenkamp
pmc-12535022.description: BackgroundThe COVID-19 pandemic, declared in March 2020, caused significant morbidity and mortality globally. This study aims to estimate the costs associated with managing COVID-19 infected patients in Regina.MethodThe study focuses on the direct and indirect healthcare costs of managing a COVID-19 case. Costing elements included are diagnostic, public health, inpatient and outpatient management costs.

pmc-12540992.title: Zinc biofortification and yield enhancement in rice with nano- primed seeds and foliar sprays
pmc-12540992.creator: Aishwarya J. Gamit, Komal G. Lakhani, Kirankumar P. Suthar, Rasmieh Hamid, Vipulkumar B. Patel, Nilima Karmakar, Jagdish V. Patel, Nitin N. Gudadhe
pmc-12540992.description: Zinc deficiency in rice, a staple food consumed by more than half of the world’s population, poses a major challenge to food safety and nutrition. In this study, the application of biosynthesized zinc oxide nanoparticles (ZnO NPs) was investigated as a sustainable strategy to solve this problem.

pmc-12651630.title: Navigating the Latest Hepatitis B Virus Reactivation Guidelines
pmc-12651630.creator: Zeyad Elharabi, Jowana Saba, Hakan Akin
pmc-12651630.description: Hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection is a global health concern with an estimated 254 million people with chronic HBV infection. The utilization of immunosuppressive therapies (ISTs) is increasing and expanding continuously with new agents being implemented across multiple medical disciplines.

pmc-13059080.title: Toward sustainable diagnostics for Candida albicans: the role of artificial intelligence in analytical chemistry from data processing to Python-based blueness and redness evaluation metrics
pmc-13059080.creator: Ahmed M. Saleh, Rabeay Y. A. Hassan, Amr M. Badawey, Hoda M. Marzouk
pmc-13059080.description: Candida albicans remains one of the most clinically significant fungal pathogens, contributing substantially to morbidity and mortality among immunocompromised and hospitalized patients. In response to the growing analytical complexity of fungal diagnostics, this review presents a unified Python-based framework structured around three fundamental and interdependent axes of contemporary C.

pmc-13078368.title: Organosilica nanoparticle-reinforced resin-based dental composites: synthesis, characterisation, and evaluation of physicochemical properties
pmc-13078368.creator: Mohammed A. Al-Khafaji, Ali O. Imarah, Athmar A. Kadhim, Mudher K. Mohammed, Hayder O. Hashim, Judith Mihály, Zoltán Varga
pmc-13078368.description: Dental nanocomposites have recently gained significant attention in the scientific community due to their ability to improve the aesthetic outcomes of dental restorations, thereby improving appearance. Despite extensive research efforts, developing dental nanocomposites that meet both mechanical and aesthetic standards remains a challenging issue. Although nanoparticles are effective at enhancing dental nanocomposite materials, they also have drawbacks.

pmc-13184948.title: An observational study of contrast-enhanced ultrasound in diagnosing malignant breast masses
pmc-13184948.creator: Apurva Surana, Akanksha Johare
pmc-13184948.description: PurposeTo study the diagnostic role of contrast-enhanced ultrasound (CEUS) in terms of sensitivity, specificity, and its comparison with grey-scale ultrasound with colour Doppler in characterising malignant breast masses.Material and methodsAn observational study was done for duration of 18 months, including 64 adult females with breast masses.

pmc-13219590.title: Modeling and experimental insight into the electronic and structural properties of Sodium alginate/Polypyrrole/Titanium dioxide nanocomposites
pmc-13219590.creator: Amira M. Salem, Reem A. Hassan, Nourhan M. S. Abd El-Rahman, Hanan Elhaes, Medhat A. Ibrahim
pmc-13219590.description: The creation of functional materials which enable adjustable electronic properties was fundamental to the development of electronic sensors and biomedical applications. The research assesses a ternary nanocomposite system which combines sodium alginate (SA) with polypyrrole (PPy) and titanium dioxide (TiO2) through dual methods of computational simulation and experimental testing.

pmc-13332572.creator: Beatrice Labella, Emmanuelle Lacene, Maud Beuvin, Anaïs Chanut, Angeline Madelaine, Favienne Levy‐Borsato, Guy Brochier, Clémence Labasse, Guillaume Bassez, Danielle Seilhean, Sarah Leonard‐Louis, Teresinha Evangelista

pmc-13468291.title: Non-Traumatic Fat Embolism Syndrome in Sickle Cell Disease Complicated by Bone Marrow Necrosis Successfully Treated with Therapeutic Plasma Exchange: A Case Report
pmc-13468291.creator: Lojain Abdullah Alsahman II, Bashair Abdullah Alnemer, Sarah Ahmed A Al Dawood, Mona Ali Alzaher, Ayat Hussain Ali Al-Mutawa
pmc-13468291.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundNon-traumatic fat embolism syndrome (NT-FES) is a rare but frequently fatal complication of sickle cell disease (SCD) that is often associated with bone marrow necrosis. A delayed diagnosis or lack of standard criteria leads to a higher mortality rate.

pmc-13503431.title: Post-marketing safety profile of palivizumab: a 20-year pharmacovigilance study using the FDA Adverse Event Reporting System (FAERS)
pmc-13503431.creator: Qing Yan, Yuke Zhong
pmc-13503431.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Palivizumab is an FDA-approved monoclonal antibody for preventing severe respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) infections in high-risk children. However, its real-world safety profile, particularly beyond clinical trial populations, remains incompletely characterized. This study aimed to systematically analyze adverse events (AEs) associated with palivizumab using two decades of data from the FDA Adverse Event Reporting System (FAERS) to identify known, novel, and rare safety signals.

pmc-13573502.title: New reference equations for lung function can affect eligibility for lung cancer surgery
pmc-13573502.creator: Nicoline Mathiessen Andersen, Kathrine Nybo Holgersen, Christian B. Laursen, Jann Mortensen, Flemming Madsen, Morten Bendixen, Maibritt Rævdal Christensen, Amanda Dandanell Juul
pmc-13573502.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). IntroductionThe standard treatment for early-stage non-small cell lung cancer is surgical resection. Assessment of operability includes evaluation of lung function. Current European guidelines are based on reference equations from the former European Community for Steel and Coal (ECSC).

uslaw-usc-t16-s256b.title: 16 U.S.C. § 256b — Hunting and fishing; general rules and regulations; protection of property; violation of statutes or rules; penalties
uslaw-usc-t16-s256b.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t16-s256b.description: United States Code, Title 16 (Conservation); Chapter 1 (National Parks, Military Parks, Monuments, And Seashores); Subchapter XXVII (Olympic National Park). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. All hunting or the killing, wounding, or capturing at any time of any wild bird or animal, except dangerous animals when it is necessary to prevent them from destroying human lives or inflicting personal injury, is prohibited.

uslaw-usc-t16-s6852.title: 16 U.S.C. § 6852 — Interagency data standardization
uslaw-usc-t16-s6852.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t16-s6852.description: United States Code, Title 16 (Conservation); Chapter 87A (Modernizing Access To Public Land). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. Not later than 30 months after April 29, 2022, the Secretaries shall jointly develop and adopt interagency standards to ensure compatibility and interoperability among applicable Federal databases with respect to the collection and dissemination of data— (1) relating to recreation sites on Federal land.
